Application/reinstatement fee after loss of good standing for failure to file an annual report.

entityTax: Corporate income tax (minimum tax of $100 to $6,000 by Vermont gross receipts, $75 for small farm corporations)

permitFee.note: Registration for a Vermont business tax account and sales and use tax license is free.

penalty.note: 5% of the tax for each month the return is unfiled, up to 25%, plus a flat $50 when filed more than 60 days late.

workersComp.agency: Vermont Department of Labor, Workers' Compensation

unemployment.note: No current official penalty amount for a late wage report was found in the state agency's published sources.

newHire.note: No current official penalty amount for a late new hire report was found; secondary sources conflict or give only the federal $25 and $500 ceilings.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: Administrative penalty of up to $100 a day for the first seven days without coverage, up to $150 a day after, and up to $250 a day after an order (21 V.S.A. 692).

paidSickLeave.note: Vermont requires sick leave for employees who average at least 18 hours a week, accruing 1 hour for every 52 hours worked with use capped at 40 hours a year; employers must post notice and tell employees at hire.

local.title: Town licenses and zoning permits
local.description: Vermont has no general business license; town zoning and local permits apply.

industry.alcohol: Vermont Department of Liquor and Lottery
